name: Zine
pitch: An opinionated, scrappy talk with a point to argue: cut, pasted, and photocopied the night before, and proud of it.

illustration.medium: flat vector photocopy-collage illustration, cut-and-paste zine aesthetic
illustration.line: heavy 5 to 6px strokes, slightly uneven, like a thick marker or photocopy edge
illustration.shapes: torn paper rectangles, tape marks, stamped boxes, deliberately off-grid placement
illustration.texture: photocopy grain and halftone noise, visible paper edges
illustration.palette_use: warm paper background dominant, near-black ink, one loud yellow used as a highlight block behind text or shapes
illustration.mood: DIY, loud, urgent, a little rebellious
illustration.avoid: gradients, smooth vector polish, 3D, soft pastel color, perfect alignment
